title: Welcome to the Post Office, Pro

slides.title: One year on
slides.text: Welcome back to Pim's post office in Netville. A year has passed, and the post is bigger than ever. So are the tricks hiding inside it.
slides.alt: Pim the owl: a round brown owl with big eyes, a cream belly and a tiny backpack.

slides.title: Not just a story
slides.text: Netville is fiction, but the problem is real. Your games, group chats, photos and streams all move as data across real networks. Real attackers really do fake messages to steal accounts and secrets, and this course is practice for your real online life.
slides.alt: Rules of the Road opens: numbered packets wait at the first router, ready to travel by the shared rules.

focus.cue: Pim's Post to Grandma's House: data on the move
Every packet is numbered for its journey

slides.title: The Magpie has help
slides.text: The Magpie no longer works alone. Its flock copies real letters, fakes the postmarks, and sends them out from fake accounts. Each fake looks almost right at first glance.
slides.alt: The faked Post Office letter with every clue found: the real address, the key ask, the rush, and a button that goes elsewhere.

focus.cue: The name says Post Office
The real address is a fake account

slides.title: Anatomy of a trick
slides.text: Here is one of the flock's tricks, taken apart after it failed. Every step of it left a small clue behind.
steps: a real letter is copied word for word
the postmark is faked to match it
a fake account sends the copy on
the reply is meant to leak a secret
the clue: the postmark date is wrong
slides.alt: Lock 3 at Pro: three cards from Pim. One postmark is stamped by a hand press, and one asks for a secret.

focus.cue: A real note, copied and signed Pim
The clue: a faked postmark

words.means: something that could harm people, messages or accounts
joined parts that work together, like the whole post network
a planned move to harm people, messages or accounts
the plan and tools used to keep something safe

slides.title: Think in systems
slides.text: Attacks on messages and accounts are a real industry, run for money and secrets. This course shows how attacks actually work, and it hands you the professional toolkit. A Cyber Defender trusts systems, not luck.
slides.alt: Design the rule set: three things go wrong on this road, and four rule cards are there to catch them.

focus.cue: Expect things to go wrong on the road
Then pick the rules that catch every one

slides.title: Six stamps, real jobs
slides.text: Six stamps wait, one per unit, and each one maps to your real life. Roadwise covers data on the move; Keykeeper, passphrases and proving it is you; Private, your footprint; Trickspotter, phishing and fakes; Kind Screen, your chats; Shield, layers that hold when one fails.

visual.label: Six stamps, one for each unit

focus.cue: Roadwise guards packets; Keykeeper guards keys
Private guards what you share; Trickspotter spots fakes
Kind Screen keeps chats kind; Shield stacks layers

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: There is no game this time. Every step is built the same way: story slides, then words, a quick check, and a mission. Open the course map and study the six stamps. Think about which stamp you want most.
slides.alt: Escape the Post Office at Pro: six trick locks guard the sorting room door, one for each Defender stamp.

focus.cue: Lock 1 waits for your first stamp: Roadwise
